claims: Lin-Manuel Miranda is directing a film adaptation of Dave Malloy's a cappella musical Octet.
The film adaptation of Octet has production starting in early 2026.
The Octet film is Lin-Manuel Miranda's second directorial film following tick, tick… Boom!.
Dave Malloy is the writer/composer of the Octet film.
Dave Malloy is adapting his own 2019 off-Broadway stage musical for the Octet film.
The Octet film focuses on eight people grappling with digital dependency and internet addiction, meeting in a church basement to share their stories.
Amanda Seyfried plays Jessica in the Octet film.
Rachel Zegler plays Velma in the Octet film.
Sheryl Lee Ralph plays Paula in the Octet film.
Phillipa Soo plays Karly in the Octet film.
Jonathan Groff plays Henry in the Octet film.
Tramell Tillman plays Marvin in the Octet film.
Gaten Matarazzo plays Toby in the Octet film.
Paul-Jordan Jansen plays Ed in the Octet film.
The Octet film is a musical.
The Octet film features an a cappella score.
The original Octet stage show features an a cappella score.
Lin-Manuel Miranda shared on Instagram that rehearsals for the Octet film have officially begun as of April 2026.
The Octet film is being produced by 5000 Broadway Productions.
Julie Oh is a key producer of the Octet film.
The original Octet stage show premiered off-Broadway in 2019.
